test_objective: Check that you can query a list of subscriptions

test_cases.name: 031_01_01 Query Subscriptions
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query a list of subscriptions
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Query Subscriptions with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Query Subscriptions with Response containing:
            * file set to 'subscriptions/expectations/subscriptions-031-01-expectation.json'
            * id set to '${subscription_ids}'
            * response set to '${response.json()}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/subscriptions/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Query Subscription Request with data: and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
